# pstdr-dsl — Language Specification for LLMs & Agents

> Authoritative, compiler-verified reference for **pstdr-dsl** (Wave 1–3C).
> Targets **Modern 2.x** (Bedrock `26.60`, `@minecraft/server 2.11.0`, `@minecraft/server-ui 2.0.0`) and **Legacy 1.x LTS** (Bedrock `1.21.50+`, `@minecraft/server 1.15.0`–`1.19.x`, `@minecraft/server-ui 1.3.0`).
> Derived directly from `crates/pstdr-lang/src/` and `data/spec/`. Full reference: `docs/LANGUAGE_REFERENCE.md`.

## 1. File Header, Directives & `ApiProfile`

```pstdr
@addon(target = "26.60", api = "2.11.0")
bind_target("BP/items/frost_blade.json")
```

- `@addon(target = "...", api = "...")`: Optional, at most one per file (`PSTDR-E016` if duplicated). Defaults to `target = "26.60"`, `api = "2.11.0"`. Can also be configured workspace-wide in `pstdr.toml` (`[bedrock] target = "..."`, `api = "..."`).
- `bind_target("<relative_path>")`: Optional (multiple allowed). Wires `BP/items/*.json` or `BP/blocks/*.json` and verifies `"identifier"` (`PSTDR-E007`, `PSTDR-E008`, `PSTDR-E009`).
- **Multi-Target `ApiProfile` Matrix (versions `< 1.15.0` are rejected with `PSTDR-E016`):**

| Feature | Modern 2.x (`2.0.0`–`2.11.x`, default) | Legacy 1.x LTS (`1.15.0`–`1.19.x`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Default Target / Manifest | `26.60` (`[1, 26, 60]`), JSON `1.21.90` | `1.21.50` (`[1, 21, 50]`), JSON `1.21.50` |
| Component Registration | `system.beforeEvents.startup` | `world.beforeEvents.worldInitialize` |
| `command` / `run_fn` / `.run_command()` | `.runCommand(...)` | `.runCommandAsync(...)` |
| `on cmd` (`customCommandRegistry`) | **Stable (Recommended)** | **Rejected (`PSTDR-E016`)** — use `on chat` |
| `on chat` (`chatSend`) | **Beta-only (`2.11.0-beta`, `PSTDR-E018`)** | **Stable** (no `-beta` required) |
| `@minecraft/server-ui` (auto-injected only when `ui` is used) | `"2.0.0"` | `"1.3.0"` |

- **Build Workflow:** Always validate and build workspaces with **`pstdr-c build --workspace`** (runs `check -> convert -> audit` sequentially, emits `// @pstdr <file>:<line>` trace comments, and catches stale `BP/manifest.json` mismatches).

## 2. Valid Top-Level Items

Only these declarations are legal at top level:
- `const <name> = <expr>` — immutable binding (`PSTDR-E002` on reassignment).
- `mut <name> = <expr>` — world/module-scoped mutable binding.
- `state <name>[<owner>] = <default_expr>` — persistent per-entity Dynamic Property (`pstdr:<name>`).
- `func <name>(<p1>, <p2>) { ... }` — validated `.pstdr` function.
- `mcfunction "<folder/name>" { ... }` — inline `.mcfunction` emitted to `BP/functions/<folder/name>.mcfunction` (`//` comments stripped).
- `every <duration> { ... }` — repeating timer (`system.runInterval`, minimum `50ms` / 1 tick, else `PSTDR-E010`).
- `after <duration> { ... }` — one-shot delayed timer (`system.runTimeout`).
- `on <event_signature> { ... }` — event handler (see Section 3).
- `unsafe <name>(<p1>, ...) { ...raw JS... }` or `unsafe const|mut|var|let <name> = ...;` — top-level raw JS escape hatch (never inside blocks or expressions, `PSTDR-E006`).

## 3. Complete Event Catalog (Wave 1–3C)

| Event | Exact Syntax | Bound Scope Variables | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Custom Command** *(3B)* | `on cmd "<ns>:<name>" description "<desc>" [permission any\|gamemakers\|admin\|host] [(<p>: <type>, <opt>?: <type>)] [by <actor>] { ... }` | params, `[<actor>]` | **Stable `2.x` slash commands** (`customCommandRegistry`); rejected on `1.x`. Types: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `player`. |
| **Chat Send** | `on chat <msg> by <actor> { ... }` | `<msg>`, `<actor>` | Cancellable; **`2.x` Beta-only (`E018`)** / **`1.x` Stable** |
| Right Click | `on right click with <item> by <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>` | Cancellable |
| Hit Entity | `on hit <target> with <item> by <actor> { ... }` | `<target>`, `<actor>` | `entityHitEntity` |
| Consume Item | `on consume <item> by <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>` | `itemCompleteUse` |
| Item Release *(3B)* | `on item_release with <item> by <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>`, `item`, `use_duration` | `itemReleaseUse` |
| Break Block | `on break of <block_id> by <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>`, `block` | Cancellable |
| Place Block *(3B)* | `on place of <block> by <actor> { ... }` | `<block>`, `<actor>` | Cancellable (`playerPlaceBlock`) |
| Block Interact | `on interact of <block_id> by <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>`, `block` | Cancellable |
| Block Tick | `on tick of <block_id> { ... }` | `block`, `dimension` | Needs `BP/blocks/*.json` (`E007`) |
| Interact Entity *(3B)* | `on interact_entity of <target> by <actor> { ... }` | `<target>`, `<actor>` | Cancellable (`playerInteractWithEntity`) |
| Player Join | `on join of <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>` | `playerSpawn` (`initialSpawn`) |
| Player Leave | `on leave of <actor> { ... }` | `<actor>` | `beforeEvents.playerLeave` |
| Dimension Change *(3B)* | `on dimension_change of <player> { ... }` | `<player>`, `from_dimension`, `to_dimension`, `from_location`, `to_location` | `playerDimensionChange` |
| Entity Hurt | `on hurt <target> [by <attacker>] { ... }` | `<target>`, `[<attacker>]` | `entityHurt` |
| Entity Die | `on die of <target> [by <killer>] { ... }` | `<target>`, `[<killer>]` | `entityDie` |
| Health Change *(3B)* | `on health_change of <entity> { ... }` | `<entity>`, `old_value`, `new_value` | `entityHealthChanged` |
| Projectile Hit | `on projectile hit <target> [with <proj>] [by <shooter>] { ... }` | `<target>`, `[<shooter>]`, `projectile` | `projectileHitEntity` |
| Projectile Hit Block *(3B)* | `on projectile_hit_block of <block> [by <shooter>] { ... }` | `<block>`, `projectile`, `<shooter>` (default `shooter`) | `projectileHitBlock` |
| Entity Hit Block *(3B)* | `on entity_hit_block of <block> by <attacker> { ... }` | `<block>`, `<attacker>` | `entityHitBlock` |
| Explosion *(3B)* | `on explosion { ... }` | `source`, `impacted_blocks` | Cancellable (`beforeEvents.explosion`) |
| Entity Spawn | `on spawn of <entity> [type <type_id>] { ... }` | `<entity>` | `entitySpawn` |
| Entity Load *(3B)* | `on entity_load of <entity> { ... }` | `<entity>` | `entityLoad` |
| Entity Remove *(3B)* | `on entity_remove of <entity> { ... }` | `<entity>` | `entityRemove` |
| Script Event *(3A)* | `on script_event "<ns>:<id>" { ... }` | `event`, `source`, `source_block` | Static `"ns:id"` required (`E016`) |
| Entity Trigger *(3A)* | `on entity_trigger "<ev_id>" [for "<entity_type>"] { ... }` | `entity`, `event_id` | `dataDrivenEntityTrigger` |

> `beforeEvents` (`on leave`, `on chat`, and cancellable events containing `cancel event`) automatically defer world-mutating actions with `system.run(() => { ... })`.

## 4. Statements, UI Forms & Scoreboards

- **Variables & Control Flow:** `const x = ...`, `mut x = ...`, `x = | += | -= | *= | /= ...`, `if ... { ... } else if ... { ... } else { ... }`, `for v in iter { ... }`, `while cond { ... }`, `return [expr]`, nested `after <dur> { ... }`, `every <dur> { ... }`.
- **Actions:**
  - `send <msg> to <target>` → `<target>.sendMessage(<msg>)` (`<target>` = player or `world`).
  - `apply <effect> <level> to <target> for <duration>` — `<level>` is **1-based** (`>= 1`, `E011`); `<effect>` checked against spec (`E013`).
  - `damage <target> by <amount>`, `ignite <target> for <duration>`, `spawn particle <id> at <entity_or_loc> [in <dim>]`.
  - `command [on <target>] "<cmd>"` → `.runCommand` (`2.x`) / `.runCommandAsync` (`1.x`); defaults to overworld.
  - `run_fn [on <target>] "<path>"` → runs `function <path>`; verifies `BP/functions/<path>.mcfunction` or inline `mcfunction` exists (`E017`).
  - `cancel event` — ONLY in `on right click`, `on break`, `on place`, `on interact`, `on interact_entity`, `on explosion`, `on chat` (`E004`).
- **Native Scoreboard *(Wave 3B)*:**
  - `score["kills"][player] = 0`, `score["kills"][player] += 1`, `score["kills"][player] -= 1`, `const k = score["kills"][player]` (null-safe, auto-creates objective).
  - `scoreboard show "<obj>" [title "<display>"] slot sidebar|list|belowname` and `scoreboard hide slot sidebar|list|belowname`.
- **Native UI Forms *(Wave 3B — auto-injects `@minecraft/server-ui` only when used)*:**
  - `ui action "<title>" [body "<text>"] to <player> { button "<label>" [icon "<tex_path>"] { ... } }` (icon paths validated by `E017`/`E009`).
  - `ui message "<title>" [body "<text>"] to <player> { button1 "<l1>" { ... } button2 "<l2>" { ... } }`.
  - `ui modal "<title>" to <player> { text_field "<l>" [placeholder "<p>"] [default "<d>"] as <var> | toggle "<l>" [default <bool>] as <var> | slider "<l>" min <n> max <n> step <n> [default <n>] as <var> | dropdown "<l>" options [...] [default <idx>] as <var> | on submit { ... } }`.

## 5. Units, Operators, Built-ins & `snake_case` Helpers

- **Duration Units (EXACT):** `ms`, `s`, `m` ONLY (`50ms` = 1 tick, `1s` = 20 ticks, `1m` = 1200 ticks). **There is NO `t` tick suffix** — use `50ms` for 1 tick, `100ms` for 2 ticks, etc.
- **Distance Units:** `5b`, `5blocks`.
- **Strings:** Double quotes ONLY with `{expr}` interpolation (`"HP: {player.hp}"`). Escape braces with `\{` / `\}`.
- **Operators:** `+ - * / %`, `== != < <= > >=`, `and`/`&&`, `or`/`||`, `not`/`!`, `?.`, `??`, `cond ? a : b`, `x in arr`, `a within b` (`<= 5` blocks).
- **`is` / `is not` Predicates:** `sneaking`, `sprinting`, `swimming`, `flying`, `sleeping`, `on_ground`, `in_water`, `holding <item_id>`.
- **Built-in Globals:** `world`, `system`, `console`, `Math` (`Math.floor`, `Math.random`, `Math.min`, `Math.max`, `Math.abs`, `Math.round`, `Math.ceil`, etc.), `JSON`, `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `Array`, `Object`, `Date`, `parseInt`, `parseFloat`, `isNaN`.
- **Validated `world.*` & `system.*` Methods:**
  - `world`: `players()`, `get_players(opts)`, `send_message(m)`, `dimension(id)`, `play_sound(id, loc)`, `play_music(...)`, `queue_music(...)`, `stop_music()`, `get_entity(id)`, `get_day()`, `get_moon_phase()`, `get_time_of_day()`, `set_time_of_day(t)`, `get_absolute_time()`, `set_absolute_time(t)`, `get_default_spawn_location()`, `set_default_spawn_location(loc)`, `get_dynamic_property(k)`, `set_dynamic_property(k, v)`, `get_dynamic_property_ids()`, `clear_dynamic_properties()`.
  - `system`: `current_tick` (property), `run(fn)`, `run_timeout(fn, t)`, `run_interval(fn, t)`, `clear_run(id)`, `run_job(g)`, `clear_job(id)`, `send_script_event(id, msg)`, `wait_ticks(n)`.
- **Exact Helper Arities (enforced by validator):**
  - `player.title(msg)` — **1 arg ONLY** (call `player.subtitle(msg)` separately).
  - `player.subtitle(msg)` — **1 arg ONLY**.
  - `player.actionbar(msg)` — **1 arg ONLY**.
  - `player.give_item(item_id, amount?, name_tag?)` — **1 to 3 args**.
  - `dim.spawn_item(item_id, loc_or_entity, amount?)`.
- **`snake_case` String & Array Helpers:** `.lower()` (`toLowerCase`), `.upper()` (`toUpperCase`), `.trim()`, `.starts_with(s)`, `.ends_with(s)`, `.contains(x)` (`includes`), `.replace(a, b)`, `.split(sep)`, `.join(sep)`, `.push(x)`.
- **Entity/Player Properties:** `name_tag`, `type_id`, `is_sneaking`, `is_sprinting`, `is_swimming`, `is_flying`, `is_sleeping`, `is_on_ground`, `is_in_water`, `is_climbing`, `is_falling`, `is_valid`, `selected_slot`, `head_location`, `view_direction`, `hp`, `max_hp`, `holding` / `mainhand` (`.id`, `.type_id`, `.name_tag`).
- **Entity/Player/Dimension Methods:** `send_message`, `play_sound` (`E013`), `add_tag`, `remove_tag`, `has_tag`, `get_tags`, `apply_damage`, `apply_impulse`, `apply_knockback`, `add_effect`, `remove_effect`, `set_on_fire`, `extinguish_fire`, `spawn_particle`, `spawn_entity`, `get_entities`, `get_players`, `teleport`, `kill`, `get_score`, `set_score`, `add_score`, `holding(id)`, `run_command(cmd)`.

## 6. Stable `2.11.0` Pattern (`on cmd` + `ui action` + `score` + `state`)

```pstdr
@addon(target = "26.60", api = "2.11.0")

state kit_cd[player] = 0

on cmd "my_pack:kit" description "Open kit selector" permission any by player {
    if kit_cd[player] > 0 {
        player.actionbar("Wait {kit_cd[player]}s")
        return
    }
    ui action "Starter Kits" body "Pick a loadout:" to player {
        button "Knight" icon "textures/items/iron_sword" {
            player.give_item("minecraft:iron_sword", 1, "§bKnight Blade")
            kit_cd[player] = 30
            score["kits_claimed"][player] += 1
            scoreboard show "kits_claimed" title "Kits" slot sidebar
            player.play_sound("random.levelup")
        }
        button "Scout" icon "textures/items/feather" {
            apply speed 2 to player for 15s
            kit_cd[player] = 30
            player.play_sound("random.orb")
        }
    }
}

every 1s {
    for p in world.players() {
        if kit_cd[p] > 0 {
            kit_cd[p] -= 1
        }
    }
}
```

## 7. Strict Anti-Hallucination & Forbidden Syntax Checklist

**Forbidden in safe mode (`PSTDR-E001`):** `class`, `extends`, `super`, `new`, `this`, `constructor`, `var`, `let`, `function`, `nil`, `then`, `end`, `import`, `export`, `require`, `eval`, `~=`, `..`. Single quotes `'...'` and backticks `` `...` `` are forbidden outside `unsafe` (`E016`).

**Never hallucinate:**
1. **NO `t` duration suffix** (e.g. `20t`) — use `50ms` for 1 tick, `1s` for 20 ticks.
2. **NO `world.get_time()` / `world.getTime()`** — rejected by `E016`; use `system.current_tick`, `world.get_absolute_time()`, `world.get_time_of_day()`, `every`, or `after`.
3. **NO 2-arg `player.title("Main", "Sub")`** — rejected by `E016`; call `player.title("Main")` then `player.subtitle("Sub")`.
4. **NO `runCommandAsync(...)` on `2.x`** — rejected by `E016`; use `command on player "..."`, `run_fn`, or target Legacy `1.x` LTS.
5. **NO `on cmd` on `1.x` LTS** — rejected by `E016`; use `on chat` on `1.x` or target `2.11.0`.
6. **NO `on chat` on stable `2.11.0`** — rejected by `E018`; use `on cmd` (Stable `2.x`), `api = "2.11.0-beta"`, or `1.x` LTS.
7. **NO `player` inside top-level `every`/`after`** — rejected by `E005`; iterate `for p in world.players() { ... }`.
8. **ALWAYS use `state key[player] = default`** for per-player data — never a global `mut`.
9. **Custom items MUST have `BP/items/<name>.json`** with a valid vanilla `minecraft:icon` alias or registered `RP/` texture (never `/`, `\`, `:`, `.png` in `minecraft:icon`, `E017`).
10. **Manifest `min_engine_version` MUST start with `1`** (`[1, 26, 60]` or `[1, 21, 50]`, NEVER `[26, 60, 0]`, `E015`).

## 8. Diagnostic Codes (`PSTDR-E001` – `PSTDR-E018`)

- `E001`: Forbidden JS/Lua keyword/operator in safe mode.
- `E002`: Reassignment to `const` (use `mut`).
- `E003`: Reserved `.pstdr` keyword used as identifier (contextual keywords like `title`, `body`, `slot`, `cmd`, `min`, `max` are allowed as variables).
- `E004`: `cancel event` outside a cancellable event.
- `E005`: Variable not in scope (e.g. `player` in `every 1s`).
- `E006`: `unsafe` used as expression or inside a block.
- `E007`: Missing `bind_target()` file or missing `BP/blocks/*.json` for `on tick`.
- `E008`: Bound JSON `"identifier"` mismatches ID in `.pstdr`.
- `E009`: Path traversal (`..`) or absolute path in `bind_target`, `mcfunction`, `run_fn`, or UI `icon`.
- `E010`: `every` interval `< 50ms` (1 tick).
- `E011`: `apply` effect level `< 1` (must be 1-based).
- `E012`: Unclosed `{` brace.
- `E013`: Unknown vanilla effect (`apply`) or sound (`play_sound`) ID.
- `E014`: Workspace not detected (`BP/` and `pstdr.toml` missing).
- `E015`: Audit Gate failed (bad `min_engine_version`, BP/RP UUID collision, or stale `BP/manifest.json` `@minecraft/server` mismatch).
- `E016`: Syntax/API error (bad token, helper arity, unknown `world.*`/`system.*`, unsupported `< 1.15.0` API, `on cmd` on `1.x`, `runCommandAsync` on `2.x`, non-namespaced `on cmd`/`on script_event` ID).
- `E017`: Invalid texture alias, missing RP texture/UI icon, or missing `.mcfunction` for `run_fn`.
- `E018`: Beta-only API (`on chat` / `chatSend` on `2.x` or Beta API in `unsafe`) used with a stable `api` version.
